reading.passage: Last summer, a terrible typhoon hit our small town near the sea. I was doing my homework when the wind suddenly became very strong. While my father was closing the windows, the lights went off. We were sitting in the dark when we heard a loud noise. Part of our roof came off! My mother was crying, but my father stayed calm. He warned us to stay away from the windows. While the storm was beating against the house, we listened to the radio for news. The report said the typhoon was slowing down. By morning, the rain had stopped. Our neighbours were cleaning the streets when the rescue team arrived with food and water. We were lucky to be safe.
reading.passageCn: 去年夏天，一场可怕的台风袭击了我们海边的小镇。当风突然变得很强时，我正在做作业。当我父亲正在关窗户的时候，灯灭了。我们正坐在黑暗中，这时听到一声巨响。我们家的一部分屋顶被掀掉了！我妈妈在哭，但我爸爸保持镇定。他提醒我们远离窗户。当暴风雨拍打着房子时，我们听收音机里的新闻。报道说台风正在减弱。到了早晨，雨停了。当救援队带着食物和水到来时，我们的邻居们正在清理街道。我们很幸运能平安无事。

writing.topic: A Day I Will Never Forget
writing.prompt: Write a short story about a day with bad weather or a natural disaster. Tell what you were doing when it happened, what you saw and how you felt. Use the past continuous tense (was/were doing) with 'when' and 'while'.
writing.promptCn: 写一个关于恶劣天气或自然灾害的小故事。讲一讲灾害发生时你正在做什么、你看到了什么以及你的感受。请使用过去进行时（was/were doing），并配合 when 和 while。
writing.opener: It was a normal afternoon, and I was ... when suddenly ...

cards.hint: 如 A strong typhoon hit our town while I was ...
如 We were hiding under the table when ...
如 The rescue team came and we were safe.

l1: It was a normal day, and I was playing at home.
Suddenly the sky turned dark and the wind became strong.
A heavy rainstorm hit our town all of a sudden. {happen}
l2: I was doing my homework when the storm started. {happen}
While my mother was closing the windows, the lights went off.
We were sitting in the dark, and we could hear loud thunder. {did}
The radio warned everyone to stay inside. {end}
l3: I was reading a book when the earthquake suddenly began to shake the house. {happen}
While we were running outside, part of the roof came off and people started to scream. {did}
We were hiding in a safe place when the rescue team finally arrived with food and water. {end}
Thankfully, everyone was safe, and I will never forget that frightening day.
